rules: The authorization binding hashes the entire canonical authorization document with only authorization_binding_sha256 omitted.
The expected authorization binding is supplied independently by the explicit user authorization; calculating a matching hash is not consent.
Authorization binds the exact first-live plan, environment, authorization ID, pricing and fixed limits; old campaign grants and v3 first-live bindings are not accepted.
The authorization window is at least 330 seconds and at most 24 hours; supplied verification time must be within it.
Pricing retrieval and authorization share the declared snapshot UTC date, retrieval precedes authorization, and full cap reservation is compared to CNY 1 using exact rational arithmetic.
The claim intent is explicitly not a reservation and authorizes no Key/task use.

For first-live only, local claim request authorization_grant_sha256 is the canonical direct-authorization document hash, and consumption_entry_sha256 is the canonical local claim-intent hash. Neither means an external campaign ledger entry.
Local claim receipt must match the intent, environment, plan, execution commit and clock domain, and be claimed between intent time and authorization expiry.
No supplied receipt alone proves that the protected store accepted it; runtime/current-store and source admission remain separate gates.
Fresh current time, exact source, real local claim, enabled collector, publication and review/registry linkage are still required before any runtime authority or first-live success.
